RESCUE. REHABILITATION. REHOME.

Amazing Grace Equine Sanctuary, Inc., is a horse rescue and adoption facility in Elkhart Lake, Wisconsin, founded in 2008. We are a 501(c)3 organization, therefore donations are tax-deductible. Our facility is dedicated to rehabilitating these magnificent animals, when possible, to their fullest physical and mental potential. Our goal, once the overall health, well-being, and soundness of a horse are accomplished, is to assess them for possible placement and adoption to a qualified owner.
